title: Level 1 German — Unit 01: Polite Greetings & Language Barriers
description: Master practical conversational dialogues in Berlin Street.

steps.npcLine: Guten Tag! Wie kann ich Ihnen helfen?
steps.npcTranslation: Hello! How can I help you?
steps.userTask: Respond appropriately in German to: 'Hello! How can I help you?'
steps.expectedResponse: Entschuldigung, sprechen Sie Englisch?

title: Level 1 German — Unit 02: Directions & Navigation
description: Master practical conversational dialogues in Berlin Transit.

steps.npcTranslation: Where do you want to go?

steps.expectedResponse: Entschuldigung, wo ist der Hauptbahnhof?

title: Level 1 German — Unit 04: Hotel Check-In & Accommodations
description: Master practical conversational dialogues in Frankfurt Hotel.

steps.npcLine: Guten Abend! Wie ist Ihr Name?
steps.npcTranslation: Good evening! What is your name?
steps.userTask: Respond appropriately in German to: 'Good evening! What is your name?'
steps.expectedResponse: Ich heiße Müller und habe ein Zimmer gebucht
